dialogues.jp: 根性で起き上がり、ベッドから下りる。
dialogues.en: Summoning all my strength, I get up and off my bed.
dialogues.text: Summoning all my strength, I get up and off my bed.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「それじゃあ、私は先に行きますから、戸締り
　お願いしますね」
dialogues.en:
"Okay, I'm going on ahead. Remember to lock the doors before
you leave!"
dialogues.text:
"Okay, I'm going on ahead. Remember to lock the doors before
you leave!"

dialogues.jp: 制服の袖に手を通し、居間に向かう。
dialogues.en:
I walk downstairs to the living room while putting on the
sleeve of my uniform.
dialogues.text:
I walk downstairs to the living room while putting on the
sleeve of my uniform.

dialogues.jp:
この時間にしては、学生の数が少ない。テスト
の日だけは登校時間が早まるみたいだな。
dialogues.en:
There are tons of students on the road to school this time
around. No one wants to be late for the day of an exam.
dialogues.text:
There are tons of students on the road to school this time
around. No one wants to be late for the day of an exam.

dialogues.jp:
お前も頑張れよ、という突っ込みはいれないこ
とにして、先に進む。
dialogues.en:
Keep it up, I think to them as I concentrate on getting to
school.
dialogues.text:
Keep it up, I think to them as I concentrate on getting to
school.

dialogues.jp: どう見ても美春な女の子が、前を歩いている。
dialogues.en: I saw Miharu ahead of me as I was walking.
dialogues.text: I saw Miharu ahead of me as I was walking.

dialogues.jp: 後ろから、肩にポンと手をのせる。

｛まぶた／瞼｝を重たそうに支えながら、美春が俺を見上げ
る。
dialogues.en: Miharu looked up at me with heavy-looknig eyelids.
dialogues.text: Miharu looked up at me with heavy-looknig eyelids.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はい……もう太陽の光が｛まぶ／眩｝しくって……」

まあ、今日の学園にはそういうヤツがごろごろ
いるんだろうが。
dialogues.en:
I don't really have the time to chat with her, I need to
study as much as possible soon.
dialogues.text:
I don't really have the time to chat with her, I need to
study as much as possible soon.

dialogues.en: "Well, do your best. I'd go ahead."
dialogues.text: "Well, do your best. I'd go ahead."

dialogues.jp:
美春には悪いが俺も１秒でも早く勉強を再開し
なければならないのだ。
dialogues.en: I didn't want to waste one second in resuming my cramming.
dialogues.text: I didn't want to waste one second in resuming my cramming.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あうぅ……朝倉先輩、待ってくださいよぅ」

情けない声をだす美春。彼女を置いて、俺は歩
を進める。
dialogues.en: Her pitiful voice cried out. I hastened my pace.
dialogues.text: Her pitiful voice cried out. I hastened my pace.

dialogues.jp: （スマンな美春。試験は戦いなのだ）
dialogues.en: "(Sorry Miharu. This is all for the exams battle.)"
dialogues.text: "(Sorry Miharu. This is all for the exams battle.)"

dialogues.jp:
遅めの登校のせいか、辺りに学生の姿はなかった。
まして、試験当日。
dialogues.en:
To prevent being late, lots of students were around when I
went to school. Typical for an exam day.
dialogues.text:
To prevent being late, lots of students were around when I
went to school. Typical for an exam day.

dialogues.jp:
と、へろへろになった美春を見かけた。徹夜を
したらしい……。
dialogues.en:
And I met a dazed Miharu on the way. She must've pulled an
all-nighter...
dialogues.text:
And I met a dazed Miharu on the way. She must've pulled an
all-nighter...
